whatItIs: NaturesMud Freeze Dried Strawberry Powder is made from sun-ripened hill strawberries grown in the cool terraced farms of Kakani and Nuwakot. Over 800g of fresh ripe strawberries are gently freeze-dried and cold-milled to produce a single 80 GM jar of fragrant, ruby-pink berry powder. It contains 0% added white sugar, 0% artificial pink dye (Red 40 / Carmine), and 0% synthetic strawberry essence.
nepaliKitchenUses: Real Strawberry Milk for Kids: Whisk 1 teaspoon (5g) of Strawberry Powder + 1 teaspoon of Dates Powder into a glass of warm or chilled milk to replace artificial strawberry syrups.
Dahi (Yogurt), Chia Pudding & Oats: Swirl 1 teaspoon into plain homemade dahi, overnight Chia Seeds pudding, or morning oatmeal for natural berry tang and Vitamin C.
Baby Porridge & Fruit Puree (6M+): Add 1/2 to 1 teaspoon into cooked apple puree, suji kheer, or rice lito (from 6 months, as advised by your pediatrician).
Natural Frosting, Lassi & Baking: Use as a 100% natural pink food color and real berry flavoring for birthday cake frosting, lassi, and homemade ice cream.
whoItSuits: Perfect for parents replacing artificial pink milk powders and sugary syrups, home bakers wanting natural berry color and flavor, smoothie lovers, and infants (from 6 months, as advised by your pediatrician).
monsoonStorage: Freeze-dried berry powders absorb atmospheric moisture rapidly on contact with humid air. Open the jar only briefly, scoop with a completely dry spoon, reseal firmly right away, and store in a cool, dry place.

faqs.q: What is the price of Freeze Dried Strawberry Powder (स्ट्रबेरी पाउडर) in Nepal?

faqs.q: Why does pure Strawberry Powder taste slightly tangy?
faqs.a: Real strawberries are naturally both sweet and tangy! Unlike commercial mixes loaded with 70% white sugar, our powder has 0% added sugar. Pair it with 1 teaspoon of NaturesMud Dates Powder for a sweeter strawberry milk.

faqs.q: Can I give Freeze Dried Strawberry Powder to my baby?
faqs.a: Yes, it is 100% pure fruit with 0 preservatives or artificial dyes, suitable for introducing berry flavors into baby porridge or yogurt from 6 months, as advised by your pediatrician.

faqs.q: How do I prevent Strawberry Powder from hardening in the jar?
faqs.a: Freeze-dried berries have zero moisture and zero chemical anti-caking agents, so they pull humidity from the air. Never hold the open jar over steaming milk/porridge, and close the lid immediately after scooping.

faqs.q: Can I use this for cake icing and baking?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Sift 1–2 tablespoons into buttercream, whipped cream, or macaron batter for vibrant natural pink color and authentic strawberry flavor without watering down your recipe.
